title: James Webb discovers a rare giant planet with surprisingly Earth-like temperatures
summary: Astronomers using NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope have uncovered a rare world unlike anything in our solar system — a giant planet about the size of Saturn with surprisingly Earth-like temperatures and an atmosphere packed with methane.
